# Installing the External Secrets Operator for Red Hat OpenShift {#external-secrets-operator-install}

The {{ external_secrets_operator }} is not installed on the OpenShift Container Platform by default. Install the {{ external_secrets_operator_short }} by using either the web console or the command-line interface (CLI).
